[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Flowery.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Current features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds Flowery, with basic dialogue lines, gift tastes, and one event.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Flowery appears at all town Festivals.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Reaching 3 hearts with Flowery unlocks the recipe for Golden Flowery Seeds, which grow flowers by the same name. These flowers can be sold as-is, but can also be turned into Golden Flowery Tea using kegs.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Planned features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]More dialogue lines & events[/*]
[*]More varied schedules[/*]
[*]Custom portrait sprites[/*]
[/list]
